The objection: A minimal transversal of a family of finite pairwise-intersecting sets need not be finite. The example: family $\{\{x, t_n\}: n \ge 1\}$ has the infinite minimal transversal $\{t_n: n\ge 1\}$.

Note: the minimal transversal $\{x\}$ is also minimal (and finite). But the point is that minimal transversals need not be finite.
